rdfs:label: DUO_0000024: This data use modifier indicates that requestor agrees not to publish results of studies until a specific date (MOR - publication moratorium)
skos:editorialNote: We interpreted this as a prohibition to not publish results until the specified date as indicated by TemplateStudyResultsPublicationDate placeholder. We also note that this rule may be expressed using odrl:delayPeriod or odrl:dateTime if it should be expressed as a (delayed) permission to publish instead of a prohibition
